items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Thursday, second straight DNP after exiting Week 4 early; considered week-to-week, availability in serious doubt for London game vs JAX.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs with hamstring; Bigsby also IR after core surgery.
items.implication: High risk of OUT/INACTIVE; Eagles backfield depleted.
items.opportunity: Lead role and carries/routes expand for remaining RBs vs JAX (allows RB receiving).

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday again; consecutive DNPs put Week 5 status in serious doubt alongside Barkley.
items.implication: Likely limited or OUT; Hurts targets thin with Brown also out.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs/TEs like Goedert (limited) or others.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) did not practice Thursday; Friday practice looms large for Sunday Night availability vs ATL. Not long-term/surgical but multi-game risk possible.
items.why: Left Week 4 early with left ankle; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Huntley likely if out; downgrade to Flowers/Andrews/Likely.
items.opportunity: If OUT, backup QB rush/pass splits change; skill players volume may shift.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) back at practice Thursday as limited participant after Wed DNP; still in protocol, needs full Fri for Sunday chance vs MIA. Promising step.
items.why: Cleared some protocol phases; dressed and participated after Wed miss.
items.implication: Upgrade path to ACTIVE if no setback; otherwise OUT boosts others.
items.opportunity: If OUT, routes/targets/redzone to Higgins (also dinged)/Gesicki/Meyers.

items.text: Levitan/ETR: 'I think it’s gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville' after Barkley/Bigsby injuries; Shipley elevated as lead with volume expected (pass-catching upside vs JAX RB-friendly receiving defense).
items.why: Barkley hamstring week-to-week + Bigsby IR/core surgery; Shipley last man, 29 snaps prior.
items.implication: Flex/RB2 viability short-term (JAX/CAR); ROS handcuff value if Barkley delayed.
items.opportunity: Carries + routes/targets expand; JAX allows high RB receiving yards/receptions.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.why: Shoulder; left Week 4 early per prior context.
items.implication: Monitor for Q/OUT; BUF WR depth tested.
items.opportunity: Targets to other BUF pass-catchers if limited/out.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) no practice again Thursday vs DEN; consecutive DNPs after aggravating in Week 4.
items.why: Foot injury left Week 4 early; missed Wed/Thu.
items.implication: High OUT risk; targets redistribute in LAC offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets up for Johnston/others if inactive.

items.text: Broncos HC Sean Payton: 'We’ll make a change offensively. I’ll call the plays.' Taking over playcalling (collaborative with Webb) after slow start, confirmed by sources and reporters.
items.why: Offense struggling; Payton expands role for spark vs LAC.
items.implication: Potential scheme/tempo/usage shift for DEN skill players.
items.opportunity: Watch snap/route/carry changes under Payton calls; possible RB/WR efficiency bump.

items.text: Berry LOVE Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume (incl red zone) + Titans defense struggles vs WRs make it a gift matchup. 'Love, love, LOVE Nico'.
Berry LOVE Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + defense carved by RBs, plus Bengals WR injuries could funnel more.
items.why: Volume + soft run D + potential pass-game spillover from Chase/Higgins.
items.conflict: Levitan xFP shows underperformance on opportunities.

items.text: Levitan xFP: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected on opportunities so far; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming on theirs. Sortable data available to subs.
items.why: Actual FP vs expected on touches/routes; efficiency signal.
items.implication: Sustain/regression watch; Bijan/Kyren buy-in, Jeanty/Brown caution or buy-low.
items.opportunity: Opportunity quality high for overperformers; volume still key for under.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown RB5 despite under xFP.

items.text: Berry LOVE Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5); volume/RZ for Wilson, coverage/positional edges for Watson/Likely.
items.why: Target volume + matchup gifts (DET pass D soft, specific weaknesses).
items.opportunity: Routes/targets elevated in good spots; Likely if Lamar limited.

items.text: First Week 5 projections live: DET-ARZ shaping up as one of most popular DFS game stacks recalled due to 54.5 total (no other >45.5) and pricing; updates continuous.
items.implication: Stack appeal for Gibbs/St. Brown/etc and ARI pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: High pace/snaps expected; ETR pace notes DET@ARI up.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Kyren 76% snaps last 2, out-touched Corum 47-14, 69% routes, 37% yards via rec; Carnell Tate season-high 43% target share (WR16 util, 73% air yards); Kincaid target share dipped to 9% recent (from 25%), 56% routes, still top-12 believer.
items.implication: Kyren locked RB1; Tate rising WR; Kincaid monitor but startable.
items.opportunity: Kyren dual-threat volume; Tate air-yards hog; Kincaid recent dip but RZ history.
